purpose: Same claim-level binding as 1.0.0. PaperDocument now carries parsed PMC tables beside full_text, and the collector copies FetchResult.tables onto that document and classifies missing_source. Binding rules are unchanged; the hash moves because the input shape extraction can feed the gate has changed.

versioning.patch: wording or provenance changes proven not to move a claim between sufficient insufficient or unknown
versioning.minor: any new refusal or changed field target population timepoint or analysis-set binding rule
versioning.major: an incompatible input/output contract or a different adequacy algorithm
